notes: One unified pass over therange.co.uk (HTTP-first: curl with browser UA + Accept/Accept-Language/Referer headers; Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenges on ~5 of ~120 requests were resolved by retrying with identical headers, no proxy/reader used). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Site is Magento-based; each category page embeds a server-rendered data-total-results attribute reflecting the live product-listing count for that exact page (cross-checked against Playwright-rendered '397 results' text on /christmas/christmas-trees/artificial-trees/ = data-total-results 398, 1-item drift from live stock changes between requests — confirms the attribute is a reliable, non-inflated qty source; also cross-checked against St Patrick's Day page where data-total-results=39 matched an exact count of 39 rendered product tiles/prices). 9 genuine holiday branches discovered and content-verified via the site's own navigation/breadcrumb/data-category taxonomy: Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Diwali (canonical root is /occasion/diwali/ — the /diwali/ root itself 404s even though several of its child Lister pages resolve fine), New Year (New Year's Eve Party branch), and St. Patrick's Day (single leaf page, no children). Thanksgiving investigated and absent: no dedicated category exists anywhere in nav/sitemap/data-category taxonomy; the only Thanksgiving-named items found (inflatable turkey lawn decor) are individual SKUs filed under Garden > Garden Decorations > Garden Ornaments, not a Thanksgiving category — correctly excluded per the shared rule that a seasonal product inside a normal category isn't a seasonal category. Grouping rows (is_group=true, qty/link-bearing parent but no own qty recorded) are used wherever a branch's own listing is a rollup/union of its children, to avoid double-counting, per rules §9/§13: Christmas, Christmas Trees, Christmas Decorations, Christmas Gifts, Christmas Homeware, Christmas Lights, Halloween, Halloween Decorations, Halloween Costumes/Masks/Accessories, Easter, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Diwali, New Year Party. Given the exceptional depth of this site's taxonomy (Christmas Decorations alone declares 34 sibling Lister sub-pages, Halloween's sitemap lists 52+ dedicated URLs), rows were capped at the distinct-product-type level rather than exhaustively itemizing every narrower facet, to keep the extraction accurate and legible rather than merely long (accuracy > completeness per rules §22): specifically excluded as redundant size/character facets rather than distinct product types — Christmas Tree size variants (3ft-8ft, each already covered by the by-style trees included: Artificial/Prelit/Slim/Snow/Real/Potted/Pop-Up/Novelty), and narrow character-specific Christmas Decoration variants (Reindeer/Santa/Elf/Penguin/Polar-Bear/Snowman/Robin/Gingerbread/Black/Bell/Candy-Cane decorations, plus Hangers&Hooks/Ceiling/Wall/Window-Stickers/Fake-Snow/Standing/Nutcrackers/Teddies/Artificial-Flowers) — all still folded into the broader Christmas Decorations grouping total. The 4 'Christmas Themes' pages (A Timeless Christmas [230 products], Amber Charm, Candy Cane Carnival, Winter Crystal) were investigated and excluded: these are curated cross-category style/mood collections (site copy: 'Bring the magic of a traditional festive season...featuring classic colours'), not a distinct product type, per rules §6 theme-vs-category distinction. 'New In', 'Sale/Offers' pages (Halloween Offers, Easter Offers) excluded as non-category marketing/filter pages per rules §17. Valentine's Day 'Gifts Under £20' (1069 products, i.e. MORE than the entire Valentine's Day root total of 528) was sampled and found to contain unrelated cross-holiday items (a 'Christmas Snowflake and Bauble Earrings' listing and generic tech/beauty products with no Valentine framing) — confirmed to be a generic sitewide price-banded gift filter merely linked into the Valentine's nav, not a genuine Valentine's-specific category, and excluded. By contrast Father's Day 'Gifts Under £25' (441 products, within the Father's Day root of 784) was sampled and found genuinely dad/gift-themed (e.g. 'Special Dad Rose Bush', grooming and DIY-tool gifts) and was kept. Christmas Gifts For Him shows data-total-results=0 at capture time (2026-09-04, well before the Christmas season ramp-up) despite the category page being live in navigation — recorded as qty 0 with a manual-review flag rather than omitted, since the category itself is genuine. All qty figures captured 2026-09-04 and will fluctuate with stock/season.
